europe_now.title: Russia closes German consulate amid escalating diplomatic tensions
europe_now.summary: Russia has closed the German consulate in St. Petersburg as tensions between the two countries escalate over an ongoing drone dispute. The closure marks a significant diplomatic setback in bilateral relations.

sources.headline: Russia shuts German consulate as drone dispute escalates

europe_now.title: Poland urges European Union to deny asylum for violent border crossings
europe_now.summary: Poland has formally called on the European Union to implement new rules denying asylum rights to individuals who forcefully and violently breach its external borders. The proposal comes amid ongoing debates across member states regarding migration policy and border security.

sources.headline: Poland urges EU to deny asylum to migrants who violently cross its borders

top_stories.title: Far-right electoral success in Germany
top_stories.summary: The Alternative for Germany party secured a major electoral victory in regional state elections. Mainstream political leaders expressed shock and concern over the outcome as discussions regarding potential government coalitions began.

sources.headline: REPLAY: 'Shocked' Merz speaks after far-right election victory

top_stories.title: Severe weather impacts French wine harvest
top_stories.summary: Intense summer heatwaves and prolonged drought have severely damaged agricultural yields across France. Consequently, national wine production has dropped significantly to historic lows.
